title: Assertion
description: L3 contract. derive(query, candidates) -> Assertion{claim, citations[]}, produced by huginn. The one hard rule at this layer: citations must be non-empty. An assertion with zero citations must be rejected before it ever reaches heimdall (L4) — an empty citation list must never pass vacuously through a verifier that only checks 'do all citations pass'.

claim.description: The natural-language (or structured) claim being asserted.

citations.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. Every claim must point at the specific evidence it rests on. This is the field most likely to be gamed (e.g. a placeholder citation) — heimdall's job is to check these are real, current, and actually support the claim, not just present.

derived_from.description: The retrieval_id this assertion was derived from, if any.

retry_of.description: If this assertion is a re-derivation attempt after a failed verification, the assertion_id it replaces. Null for a first attempt. orlog allows exactly one re-derivation per original assertion (DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md state machine).

citation_id.description: Identifier for the evidence this citation points to, e.g. a log event_id or an external source reference.

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt of the cited evidence.
